description:
800W Fat Tire Electric Bike with LCD Display & Dual Disc Brakes
Ready for rugged adventures? Then take on the road with the Micargi 800-watt motor, packed with plenty of reserved power and designed for smooth, comfortable rides. This mountain bike is built to handle tough terrains, featuring corrosion-proof components that are made to last. Whether you’re heading to school, running errands, or commuting to work, this electric bike ensures a smooth ride every time, getting you where you need to go with ease and reliability.
Fat Tires: Built for the tough challenges, the fat tires do not fear the treacherous paths, you can drive the bike through anything with ultimate ease and comfort.
Throttle Mode: You get the ease and comfort to pass through anything immediately without the need to pedal hard.
Performance Saddle: The impact of the shocks are muted down so you can sit through the rough patches at comfort.
Multi-Functional LCD: The LCD lets you track the performance and the vital details like time, riding mode, speed and distance.
The Micargi Steed supports a Bafang 250-watt electric hub motor designed to ride comfortably on the pavements and the sidewalk. The Micargi Steed has been considered as the ideal ride perfect to take you for running daily errands and for work commutes.
You won’t feel the bumps with the fat tires and easily pass through them, experiencing the utmost comfort. Fat tires have a wide contact surface with the ground, which provides great traction on all surfaces.
The dimensions of the Micargi frame is 59” (LX12 inches W X 31 inches; height 60 lbs). The overall bike weight is 60 lbs. The electric bike has a KMC heavy-duty drive chain and comes equipped with large LED lights for a safe riding experience at night.
The bike can go at the top speed of 20 miles per hour, so you will reach your destination quickly. The throttle mode and the pedal-assist feature improve the overall performance of the bike. The electric assist provides a push to the vehicle in a matter of minutes.
If you want to enjoy a completely free ride engage the throttle feature to provide it an instant push. When headed to longer journeys, the electric assist modes will help save you from physical fatigue.
The 7-speed Shimano Tourney transmission and derailleur can choose from various riding gears to climb up the steep hills. You are ensured complete safety as the dual disc brake set at the front and the rear offer complete control over the bike.
